paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization to Minimize the Wake-Induced Turbulence Effect on Wind Turbines

queries: exact title plus code and GitHub
Lichao Cao plus NSGA-II plus wind farm

public_source_search.paper_data_statement: supporting data available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request

paper_equations.added_turbulence: Eqs. 1-11, including maximum upstream superposition and ambient quadrature
paper_equations.power: Eqs. 12-18, MTG wake, Katic squared-deficit superposition, and probability-weighted farm power
paper_equations.objectives: maximize Ptotal and minimize maximum comprehensive inflow streamwise turbulence
paper_equations.ideal_constraints: continuous real coordinates in 2 km by 2 km; pair distance greater than 5D
paper_equations.zhuanghe_constraints: Eq. 27 boundary and pair distance greater than 4 times the larger rotor diameter

paper_native_cases.wind: 36 ten-degree directions by speeds 8, 12, and 17 m/s
paper_native_cases.probability_source: deterministic numerical digitization of paper Fig. 9

paper_native_cases.wind_direction_source: deterministic numerical digitization of paper Fig. 20b
paper_native_cases.wind_speed_source: shape-2 Weibull reconstruction constrained to paper annual mean 6.9 m/s, six midpoint probability bins
paper_native_cases.ambient_turbulence_source: deterministic analytic digitization of paper Fig. 21
paper_native_cases.unpublished_turbine_completion: CT=0.8 and cubic-to-rating curves with 3/12/25 m/s cut-in/rated/cut-out

missing_information: NSGA-II population, generations, crossover, mutation, termination, and repeat count
Zhuanghe original coordinates and numerical wind-resource arrays
raw Pareto fronts and optimizer traces

optimizer.crossover: Deb simulated binary crossover, probability 0.9, distribution index 20
optimizer.mutation: Deb polynomial mutation, per-coordinate probability 1/(2N), distribution index 20
optimizer.selection: binary tournament by nondomination rank then crowding distance
optimizer.reason: standard NSGA-II completion; twenty generations yields 2100 complete-layout evaluations and is consistent with the plotted complete-solution-set order of magnitude

declared_completions.rotor_average: eight deterministic equal-area rotor samples for Eq. 15 and the turbine-level Eq. 11 quantity
declared_completions.initialization_and_repair: deterministic feasible reference lattices, counter-keyed perturbations, and rejection repair respecting each paper boundary and spacing rule

parallel_regions: initial population construction and constraint repair
mathematical_reformulations: wind trigonometry computed once per state and layout
single sorted downstream sweep jointly propagates turbulence-dependent wake expansion and power
fixed-order reductions preserve one/all-core scientific identity
hpc.formal_resource_rule: one process owns all twenty Waffle cores; cases and seeds run sequentially to avoid nested oversubscription

claim_boundary: Academic flexible declared reconstruction of the target method and every paper problem; not author-code, private-data, random-bitstream, or numerical-result replay.
